title: OpenRecet System Boundary Event Stream Schema v1
description: Formal specification for observing, recording, and comparing external system boundary interactions across Win32, DirectInput, Filesystem, INI, Audio, Window, and Mutex APIs (roadmap docs/plans/parity-evidence-roadmap.md §12 BT-00).

stream_id.description: Deterministic SHA-256 digest computed over canonical event stream preimage.

scenario.description: Scenario name or test identifier (e.g. house-firstcust-arrprobe).

target.description: Execution origin of the boundary event stream.

events.description: Ordered sequence of normalized system boundary events.

logical_frame.description: Logical anchor-relative frame coordinate [anchor, occurrence, offset].

thread_id.description: Logical thread index (0 = main engine thread, 1 = worker thread).

api.description: API or interface method name (e.g. CreateFileA, IDirectInputDevice8::GetDeviceState).

args.description: Normalized arguments with pointers and platform-specific handles replaced by canonical object IDs.

result.description: Normalized return value or status code.

buffer_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of read/written buffer payloads (zero raw proprietary bytes stored).

buffer_size.description: Size in bytes of the associated payload buffer.

side_effects.description: Observable external side effects (e.g. file mutations, volume changes, focus shifts).

caller_va.description: Observed caller virtual address inside executable.
